description: Buy a plan: vaga (1 more tool), equipe (50 more tools and up to 10 private projects), empresa (500 more tools and up to 10 private projects). Each purchase lasts 30 days, with no automatic renewal. Answers 402 with the price; pay with x402 or prepaid credit and repeat. Each purchase lasts 30 days, with no automatic renewal. Without payment, the answer is 402 with the price. Pay with prepaid credit (`X-Credito`) or x402 (`PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` v2 or `X-PAYMENT` v1). Without an account, the verified paying wallet owns the purchase. Use wallet agent authentication to read its plan, or claim it after account sign-in. The `compra` mark prevents repeat credit debits. An x402 nonce can settle only once; keep the receipt after a delivery error.
